narrative.intro: Flightsafety Defense shows a large concentration of federal work in FY2026 to date, with total obligations of $665M across 6 awards and an average award size of $111M. Obligations are up 778.1% year over year. Fiscal-year history before FY2026 is steady and much smaller: FY21 obligations were $78.9M, FY22 were $74.2M, FY23 were $99.7M, FY24 were $81.3M, and FY25 were $75.7M. The FY2026 total reverses that multi-year pattern and drives the year-over-year increase. Industry exposure is highly focused: Other Aircraft Parts and Auxiliary Equipment Manufacturing accounts for $641M of FY2026 obligations, and Flight Training accounts for $23.8M. The awards table counts 6 actions and lists average award size as $111M, which aligns with the large FY2026 total. These figures are partial, reflecting fiscal year to date totals rather than a full fiscal year.
